name: Munica
body:
Benefit: The munica is a padded, flexible arm covering of linen or leather, typically worn with padded shin guards. Although scant protection, lightly armored gladiators learn to make the most of it. The munica counts as light armor and partial armor.

Adventuring Classes: A Fistful of Denarii. Copyright 2009, Robert J. Grady. All rights reserved.
